data.Job_Description: SEHYOG Academy is seeking a qualified and passionate Spanish Language Teacher to deliver high-quality instruction aligned with the UK Curriculum (GCSE and AS/A-Level standards). The candidate will be responsible for planning, delivering, and assessing engaging Spanish lessons that develop students’ proficiency in listening, speaking, reading, and writing. The role requires strong subject expertise, familiarity with examination board (AQA, OCR, Edexcel, Cambridge) requirements, and the ability to prepare students for academic success in external examinations. Requirements Educational Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in: Spanish Language Modern Foreign Languages Linguistics Or related field Teaching qualification (PGCE, B.Ed., or equivalent) preferred. Certification in UK Curriculum teaching (desirable).
